info.name: SS-6400 Preprod GTT cabin cache
info.description: Run once in displayed order: Y,Q,C,J,P,F,omitted. TC-05/06 use SFO-LHR and deliberately seed P before F. Cache criteria require correlated GTT logs; response-only tests cannot establish cache behavior.

request.description: GTT CabinType=Economy; uses its own converted-cabin cache entry and rules. Cache acceptance requires separately correlated Preprod logs; HTTP success is not cache proof.

exec: pm.variables.set("scenario_id", "TC-01");
pm.test("Search returns JSON results array", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().results).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test.skip("Cache acceptance requires correlated GTT GetMarkups/cache logs", function () {});
if (pm.response.json().results.length === 0) console.warn("WARN/NO_DATA: empty inventory");
